title: Axiomatizing Local Asymptotic Minimax Risk
abstract: arXiv:2609.19738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Local asymptotic minimax (LAM) risk is a foundational efficiency criterion in statistics and econometrics. The literature uses two definitions of LAM risk: one which appears in classical lower bounds and another which appears in arguments establishing attainment of those bounds. Conventional efficiency arguments are consistent with any estimator-dependent weighted average of the two, and consequently do not reveal which of these generalized $\alpha$-LAM risk indices describes researchers' actual preferences. We take a decision-theoretic approach to systematically resolve this ambiguity. We axiomatically characterize the set of preferences with a generalized $\alpha$-LAM representation, and we document that such preferences may violate basic rationality requirements such as Monotonicity. Motivated by this, we axiomatically characterize the subset with constant-weight representations. Within this class, a Sample Uncertainty Aversion axiom

translated_title: 公理化局部渐近极小极大风险
translated_abstract: 局部渐近极小极大（LAM）风险是统计学和计量经济学中的一个基础效率准则。文献中存在两种LAM风险的定义：一种出现在经典下界证明中，另一种出现在论证这些下界可达性的过程中。传统的效率论证与两者的任何依赖于估计量的加权平均均相容，因而无法揭示这些广义α-LAM风险指数中究竟哪一个刻画了研究者的真实偏好。我们采用决策理论方法系统地解决这一模糊性。我们公理化地刻画了具有广义α-LAM表示的偏好集合，并证明这类偏好可能违反单调性等基本理性要求。受此启发，我们进一步公理化地刻画了具有常数权重表示的偏好子集。在该类中，一个样本不确定性厌恶公理……
tldr: 本文采用决策理论公理化方法系统解决了局部渐近极小极大（LAM）风险两种定义之间的模糊性，证明了广义α-LAM偏好可能违反单调性等基本理性要求，并通过样本不确定性厌恶公理刻画了具有常数权重表示的偏好子集。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves the ambiguity between the two definitions of local asymptotic minimax (LAM) risk through a decision-theoretic axiomatic approach, showing that generalized α-LAM preferences may violate basic rationality requirements such as Monotonicity and characterizing the constant-weight subset via a Sample Uncertainty Aversion axiom.
